title: Racer
scope: Local only. No push, remote build or publication.

checks.fullBrowserRace: passed; ordinary input, two laps, 16 checkpoints
checks.productionApp: passed; catalogue, new/old URLs, pause/exit and portrait-phone landscape frame

checks.json: Authored 3D Racer opens with recovered meshes and no native Unity download or external calls.
Start, countdown, automatic acceleration and ordinary keyboard steering work.
Analog steering responds and releases; phone landscape controls fit without a surrounding handheld frame.
Ordinary keyboard steering/braking/boosting finishes two laps, records checkpoints, result and personal best. Automated play is not human acceptance.
Reload restores Racer progress; a second account has independent progress.
Host disposal unmounts the renderer and control listeners.
mobile-controls.json: Two fingers can steer and boost together; cancellation clears both inputs.
Larger controls fit 851×393, 667×375 and 568×320; manual acceleration keeps telemetry clear.
Quick Race remains fully visible on the smallest tested landscape screen.
app-checks.json: Production catalogue launches RACER at /play/racer with the new cover and no nested native client.
Production play/pause and sport-page exit work through the account-owned host.
The old /play/f1-racing address launches Racer compatibly.
A portrait phone enters the real app landscape surface with the enlarged touch controls.
